The '''Dread Host''', also known as the '''Dread Guard''', were a group of brainwashed [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were under the control of the [[Dread Masters]]; the six powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] who served the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] for centuries as prophets, generals and advisors.<ref name="TOR" /> The Dread Host was deployed in a series of campaigns by the Dread Masters in order to secure locations, artifacts, and other resources necessary for their campaign of terror across the galaxy. Initially deployed to [[Denova]], the Host would be seen subsequently on [[Asation]], [[Section X]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[Darvannis]], and lastly [[Oricon]], where it was eventually defeated along with the Dread Masters themselves.<ref name="TOR" />

==Organization==
The Dread Host answered only to the Dread Masters, opposing both the Republic and Sith Empire. It was composed of individuals recruited or mentally enslaved into service from both groups, but was organized along the lines of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. Many soldiers retained their Imperial gear and uniforms, especially when deployed to Section X. When encountered on Oricon the uniforms had changed, favoring [[Color/Legends|red]] instead of [[Color/Legends|black]]. The Dread Host [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Malora Pradon]] who an Imperial officer's uniform shaded in red, rather than gray.<ref name="TOR" /> It was primarily a ground force, with no known space combat encounters.

The Dread Host included large numbers of Sith combatants, integrated into the units alongside [[Imperial soldier|troopers]]. On Oricon units also included [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The precise rank structure of the Dread Host is unknown, but soldiers and Sith were both found in command roles. The Dread Masters were the unquestioned high command.

==History==
===Formation===
The Dread Host was formed during the renewed [[Galactic War]], following the freeing of the Dread Masters from [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]]. This military unit broke free of the Imperial Military following the presumed [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], which freed the Dread Masters from his control.<ref name="TOR" />

The precise origins of the Dread Host were not known to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The unit included Imperial troops and Sith that had served them prior to capture, Imperials defecting to their service, and individuals converted to their forces through their powers of fear and madness. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] research indicated that the later group was the largest, with only a few willingly serving the Dread Masters. Attempts to heal the damage done to captured members of the Host failed entirely as they had suffered immensely under the constant psychological manipulations of their masters. The result of this brainwashing had left the Host members not only completely loyal but also paranoid and incurably insane.

===Terror from Beyond===
A portion of the Dread Host was sent to Asation in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] with the intent of summoning the being known as the [[Lotek'k|Terror From Beyond]]. This unit was commanded by the reconstructed [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Kephess]].<ref name="TOR" /> These forces successfully overcame and corrupted the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] defenses and began to open the [[hypergate]]. However, the Gree requested aid from the Republic and Sith Empire and a strike team was dispatched to the planet. The Dread Host forces stationed there, including commanders [[Ciphas]], [[Heirad]], and [[Kel'sara]], were killed.<ref name="TOR" /> Despite this defeat the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] believed the unit had successfully transmitted some information off-planet, including hypergate technology.

===Section X===
The Dread Host was dispatched to Section X on Belsavis in order to secure [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] artifacts and other technology located in the vaults there. Of principle interest were the [[Aurora Cannon]] weapon and the wreckage of the ''[[Fatality]]'' a vessel they had caused to crash there years earlier and containing a cargo of [[HK-51]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]].<ref name="TOR" /> This effort was opposed by both Republic and Imperial forces. The Aurora Cannon was destroyed by a strike team and the [[Unidentified Dread Guard commander|Dread Guard Commander]] guarding it was slain. A spacer recovered the necessary [[HK-series assassin droid|HK-series]] components to reactivate an HK-51 droid and took possession of the ''Fatality'' after killing a Dread Host Sith known as the [[Lord of Agony]].<ref name="TOR" />

===The Dread Seeds===
In [[3638 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tagriss]] commanded a unit of the Dread Host during his [[Raid on the Arcanum|raid]] on the [[Arcanum]], successfully stealing the [[Seeds of Rage]]. These devices were spread across the galaxy, but they were recovered by a spacer and Tagriss was [[Confrontation on Ilum|killed]] in a base on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" />

===Darvannis===
Dread Master [[Styrak]] took a portion of the Dread Host with him to Darvannis during his mission to recruit [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] forces to his cause.<ref name="TOR" /> This unit attempted to defeat the strike team sent to disrupt the mission, but was destroyed along with their master.

===Oricon===
Significant portions of the Dread Host were stationed on Oricon, surrounding the [[Dread Fortress]], the apparent base of operations for the Dread Masters. These units defended the fortress against attacks by the Republic's [[Strike Team Oricon]] and the Empire's [[Dread Executioners]].<ref name="TOR" /> The Dread Host's numbers were supplemented by Corruptor droids, [[tendrils]] produced by the [[Bothrium Beast]], corrupted lifeforms, and many corrupted and insane Imperial and Republic troops and [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].

Initially able to drive back the attackers to their camps and, with the assistance of the Dread Master's fear induction almost overrun them, the Dread Host was turned back after the arrival of enemy reinforcements and the formation of a temporary alliance between Republic and Imperial forces. The Dread Host was subsequently decimated by enemy action. The Bothrium Beast was slain and the terraforming project destroyed. A spacer infiltrated the central watchtower and seized the control computer located there, killing Commander [[Zaoron]] when he attempted to defend it.<ref name="TOR" />

The Dread Masters then ordered ships launched to carry a plague of terror to hundreds of worlds across the galaxy, but a strike team penetrated the outer perimeter of the Dread Fortress, destroyed the transports, and killed the commanders guarding them. Shortly thereafter another strike team, possibly even the same one, penetrated the Dread Fortress, killing Dread Master [[Brontes]] and locating the portal to the [[Dread Fortress]].<ref name="TOR" /> There the Dread Masters were slain by the strike team. This resulted in the dissolution of the Dread Host.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dread Masters are initially released as a result of player actions in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' at the conclusion of the Imperial quest line on the planet Belsavis. A considerable portion of endgame content produced since the initial release of the game covers the subsequent actions of the Dread Masters. The Dread Host usually appears in the role of general mobs in quest areas where the Dread Masters are active, and during operations featuring the plans and schemes of the Dread Masters. With the release of Operation: The Dread Palace and the in-game death of the Dread Masters the role of the Dread Host may be considered concluded.

A [http://www.swtor.com/info/news/blog/20130913 developer blog] provides in-universe entry on this organization.
